changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0054. Store pending approval requests created by existing require-approval settings. Index review: PK_ApprovalRequests; UX_ApprovalRequests_PendingSource keeps one pending request per source; IX_ApprovalRequests_TenantId_Status_CreatedAt serves the inbox; IX_ApprovalRequests_TenantId_RequestType_Status filters type; IX_ApprovalRequests_TenantId_RequestedByUserId filters the requester. Performance note: every list index leads with TenantId and the pending inbox seeks status plus created time.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.ApprovalRequests ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, RequestType NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, SourceId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, RequiredPermission NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, Title NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, Summary NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, Reason NVARCHAR(500) NULL, DecisionComment NVARCHAR(500) NULL, RequestedByUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, RequestedByName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, DecidedByUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, DecidedByName NVARCHAR(200) NULL, DecidedAt DATETIME2 NULL, MemberProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RelatedLabel NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, Days INT NULL, OriginalEndDate DATE NULL, ProposedEndDate DATE NULL, Amount DECIMAL(19, 4) NULL, Currency NVARCHAR(3) NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_ApprovalRequests PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_ApprovalRequests_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_ApprovalRequests_RequestedBy FOREIGN KEY (RequestedByUserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_ApprovalRequests_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Pending', N'Approved', N'Rejected')), CONSTRAINT CK_ApprovalRequests_Days CHECK (Days IS NULL OR Days > 0) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_ApprovalRequests_PendingSource ON app.ApprovalRequests (TenantId, RequestType, SourceId) WHERE Status = N'Pending' AND DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_ApprovalRequests_TenantId_Status_CreatedAt ON app.ApprovalRequests (TenantId, Status, CreatedAt DESC); CREATE INDEX IX_ApprovalRequests_TenantId_RequestType_Status ON app.ApprovalRequests (TenantId, RequestType, Status); CREATE INDEX IX_ApprovalRequests_TenantId_RequestedByUserId ON app.ApprovalRequests (TenantId, RequestedByUserId);
